facts.fact: NAM-CSIRT's 2025 report has a section on secured electronic signature accreditation under the Electronic Transactions Act of 2019, which gives electronic signatures the same legal weight as handwritten ones; the report carries no date of issue, so its published date is used.
The report states CRAN is operationalising regulations under the Act on secured electronic signature accreditation; the report carries no date of issue, so its published date is used.
